parent_objective: design measured execution protocol for the metric-specific bounded panel
blocked_by: M1774 admits measured execution design after reset-only feasibility passes
supersedes: direct bounded-panel measured execution without design

public_gates: M1775 must pre-register exact bounded-panel specs matrix output directory and seed base
M1775 must identify whether existing execution infrastructure can run 24-spec 288-cell bounded panels or requires adapter implementation
M1775 must pre-register required episode counts aggregate artifacts and metric completeness gates
M1775 must keep execution interpretation deferred to a later audit
M1775 must not run rollout train replay PPO promote use private holdout change actor inputs tune profiles rank controller families or claim paper-level evidence
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run full environment rollout

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs measured execution over the reset-feasible bounded panel without rollout
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: execution design only; no reset, rollout, training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, controller ranking, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if design omits bounded-panel-specific executor adaptation needs
stop if required artifacts or pass/fail gates are incomplete
stop if design admits interpretation without later audit
stop if design changes actor inputs reward termination behavior or profile configs
fallback_plan: route to bounded-panel execution adapter implementation if current executor is incompatible
route to measured execution if existing infrastructure is sufficient
route to design repair if exact inputs or gates remain ambiguous
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1774 admits measured execution design after reset-result audit

admission_evidence: M1774 audits M1773 as 288/288 reset feasible with zero sampling failures and clean guardrails
blocked_shortcuts: do not claim controller ranking or level3 self-identification
allowed_updates: M1775 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for adapter implementation, measured execution, or design repair
next_stage_criteria: design fixes exact inputs output dir seed base and required artifacts
bounded-panel executor compatibility is explicitly handled
metric completeness and no-ranking guardrails are explicit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: high; execution design cannot prove history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: design must preserve L1, L2-current-tiled, L2 history-window, L3-online, and L3-reset controls
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If execution design is incompatible with bounded panels, route to adapter implementation instead of weakening claim standards.
allowed_claims: no reset, rollout, training, replay, PPO, private-holdout, promotion, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A measured execution protocol can be designed over the fixed M1771 bounded panel before any rollout.
success_criteria: design fixes bounded panel specs matrix output dir and seed base
design handles executor compatibility or explicitly routes to adapter implementation
design lists required artifacts metric completeness gates and guardrails
next route is measured execution adapter implementation design repair or stop
reset rollout training replay PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes ranking and level3 claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: design omits exact input paths output dir seed base metric completeness or required artifacts
design admits interpretation without later audit
reset rollout training replay PPO private holdout promotion or actor-input changes occur
paper-level or level3 claims are made

commands.name: design
commands.command: write bounded-panel measured execution design without running rollout

decision_rule: M1775 passes if it pre-registers a complete bounded-panel measured execution protocol before any reset or rollout.
